basic_profile.bio: A passionate sim racing enthusiast based in the UK, I spend my days working as a mechanical engineer, and my evenings diving into the latest racing simulations. With a background in automotive design, I have a keen interest in how physics and realism are translated into the digital racing world. When I'm not racing online, you might find me working on my classic car restoration project or hiking in the countryside with my partner. I'm online mostly during the evenings and weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a degree in Mechanical Engineering and over a decade working in the automotive industry, I've developed a deep understanding of vehicle dynamics and performance. My passion for racing simulations began in university and has grown through years of self-teaching and participation in online racing communities. I stay current by following industry news and engaging with other enthusiasts on forums and subreddits.
